products.name: Waveshare ESP32-H2-Zero
products.hardwareRevision: retained schematic/CAD revision; sale revision unspecified
products.summary: 无板载显示屏；4 MiB Flash，无PSRAM。
limitations: 部分适配：独立 ESP32-H2 SRAM 运行时已经原生验证 BOOT GPIO9、UART0 和 GPIO8 的 RMT RGB；完整原厂应用尚未通过。
Only explicit SRAM app-direct loading is supported. ROM, flash-cache/MMU, interrupt routing, USB, Bluetooth and IEEE802.15.4 remain unimplemented. No C6 SoC/ROM alias.
Hardware flash remains4MiB with noPSRAM. Header capacities1/2/4MiB fit; larger headers fail. Wafer revision is unverified, so full min=0 and max=0/65535 are required; deprecated byte14 is ignored.

Native evidence: docs/evidence/waveshare-h2-sram-2026-11-23/native-execution.ndjson and native-tests.log. Authored fixture is diagnostic only, never manufacturer firmware or a default public catalogue image.
厂家原始图像与固件保持原字节；来源冲突、实际失败与UNKNOWN结构均明确保留。
3D为保留厂家CAD或明确尺寸/照片估计，不能据此声称装配尺寸、浏览器WebGL或物理校准通过。
No original manufacturer H2 image executed. Authored SRAM diagnostic executes independently on both exact H2 boards; native evidence is separate from original firmware acceptance.
True esp32h2 identity and complete representative image chipID16 retained. No C6 board alias or C6 ROM is assigned.
The initial source/model batch had no H2 runtime. Independent H2 SRAM/GPIO/UART/RMT native execution is now verified by core5972cabf; full original applications remain unaccepted.
All18 official example images are hash-pinned references. Representative ESP-IDF blink merged image has valid bootloader/app checksums and partition MD5; this is layout verification, not execution.
Published18×23.5-mm XY and2.54-mm header pitch retained. No matching solid CAD in recorded scope; PCB layout/height remain UNKNOWN and the USB envelope explicitly estimated.
